title: On the Apparent Conflict Between Individual and Group Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a theoretical analysis of fairness concepts in machine learning and does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements, including those related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to the topic.
